Task: Focus on and type text into the 'Type anything...' input field.
Expected Result: When the field receives focus, its `box-shadow` styling changes from an inset shadow to an outset shadow. Typed text appears in the field.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
